meta.name: ammo-mmd-physics-hacks
meta.description: 应对 WebGL 端 MMD 物理 (Ammo.js) 炸模、穿模、卡顿等极限边缘工况的终极调优指南与 Hack 技巧。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 调优 WebGL 端 MMD 物理模拟，解决炸模穿模卡顿
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在 WebGL 项目中使用 MMD 模型并遇到物理模拟问题。
copy.tagline_en: Fix MMD physics explosion and clipping on WebGL.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with MMD models in WebGL and face physics issues.

howto.what: 装上后，当你在浏览器中用MMD模型遇到物理炸模、穿模、卡顿等问题时，Claude会给出具体的调优技巧，包括调整空间锚点、解决穿透、限速、局部重力等代码级方案。
howto.when: 当你描述MMD模型出现衣服拉长炸裂、旋转撕裂、平躺坍塌、卡死冻结等物理异常时触发。

say.text: 我的MMD模型衣服被拉成面条了，怎么办？
say.note: Claude会给出Mode 2空间锚点修复方案。

say.text: 平躺时裙子穿模到身体里了。
say.note: Claude会建议局部重力和局部地板。

say.text: 高密度骨骼卡死了，怎么优化？
say.note: Claude会提供差异化护盾和迭代次数调整。

howto.what_en: When enabled, Claude provides specific tuning techniques for Ammo.js MMD physics issues in WebGL, such as fixing anchor points, ghost penetration, velocity limiting, local gravity, and differential shielding.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you describe MMD physics anomalies like stretching, tearing, collapsing on lying down, or freezing with high-density bones.

say_en.text: My MMD model's clothes are stretching into noodles, what do I do?
say_en.note: Claude suggests Mode 2 spatial anchor fix.

say_en.text: Skirt clips through body when lying flat.
say_en.note: Claude recommends local gravity and floor.

say_en.text: High-density bones cause freezing, how to optimize?
say_en.note: Claude advises differential shields and iteration adjustments.
